prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely, Step by Step
plan.description: Learn how to change a flat tire safely: park, loosen the lug nuts, jack up the car, swap the wheel and tighten everything. A calm, practical walkthrough anyone can follow.

beats.narration: A flat tire on the roadside feels like a disaster. It is not. With a few tools and about twenty calm minutes, almost anyone can fix it. Here is how.

props.alt: car with flat tire by the road

beats.narration: First, get safe. Pull over on flat, firm ground, away from traffic. Turn on your hazard lights, set the parking brake, and put the car in park.
Next, gather your tools. You need the spare tire, a jack, and a lug wrench. They are usually under the trunk floor. Check your owner's manual if you cannot find them.
Now loosen the lug nuts before lifting the car. Turn the wrench left, counterclockwise, and the nuts go loose. Only break them free. Do not remove them yet.
Then place the jack on the strong metal frame point near the flat tire. Your manual shows the exact spot. Raise the car until the flat tire is just off the ground.

props.alt: mechanic raising a car with a jack

beats.narration: With the car lifted, unscrew the lug nuts the rest of the way and keep them together. Then pull the flat tire straight toward you and set it aside.
Line up the spare with the bolts and push it on. Hand-tighten the lug nuts, working in a star pattern, so the wheel sits evenly against the car.

props.alt: person putting a tire on a car

beats.narration: Lower the car slowly until the tire touches the ground. Remove the jack. Then tighten every nut firmly with the wrench, again in a star pattern.
Remember, many spare tires are temporary. Drive slowly, avoid long trips, and check the spare's air pressure soon. Then get the flat repaired or replaced.
So a flat is only a short job. Park safe, loosen, lift, swap, tighten. Learn it once, and the next flat will not scare you.

props.text: Park safe, loosen, lift, swap, tighten.
